_meta.source: Nayroz mobile shared module (Kotlin) — generated by a throwaway JUnit test (shared/src/androidUnitTest/.../tmpgolden/TmpGoldenTest.kt, deleted after use) walking the rows below through the real runtime, then rounded to 4 dp by a script.
_meta.rounding: every number under `out` is rounded to 4 dp (whole numbers as ints, -0 as 0); every INPUT (p, w, h, spec, slots, localMs, text, lines, intensity, seed) is exact — Float inputs are written as their shortest decimal, the value the Kotlin used.
_meta.visual: resolveLayerAnimationVisualState(LayerTimelinePlaybackState(isVisible=true, localMs=0, progress=p, animation=spec, isExiting=exiting), w, h, layerIndex). `p` is the progress the resolver RECEIVES — exit rows pass 1 - u (their k says u=…). spec is used exactly as given, params included.
_meta.timeline: resolveTimelinePlaybackStateFor(hidden=false, timelineStartMs=0, timelineEndMs=layerDurationMs, animations=slots, playheadMs=localMs, totalDurationMs=layerDurationMs), then resolveLayerAnimationVisualState(state, w, h, layerIndex) — the composed visual (§8.2).
_meta.units: canvaTextUnits(text, unit, lines): lines = line index per REAL grapheme (null = one line); out.graphemes are the real graphemes only (no pseudo newline items); unitOfGrapheme is aligned with them; unitCount counts the pseudo items too. Graphemes: base + following Mn/Mc/Me (Unicode 17.0 table), ZWJ joins the next code point, variation selectors attach. Whitespace = Unicode White_Space, CJK = Canva's $ri ranges, both tested on ANY code point of the grapheme. An empty paragraph's pseudo item takes the previous item's line.
_meta.unitVisual: canvaUnitVisual(type, unit, fill, intensity, seed, durationMs, exiting, p, unitIndex, unitCount) + canvaUnitElementScale(...same, no unitIndex). `p` is the RAW slot progress (p entering, u exiting). Vd = clamp(intensity - .5, 0, 1); NEON always fits (fill ignored); seed null = P 1.
_meta.outFields: s sx sy rot tx ty a blur mask{kind progress featherFraction|startAngleDegrees edge anchored} text{progress mode durationMs} glyph{type progress durationMs canva?{unit fill isExiting intensity seed restAlpha restScale restBlurPx}} bar{leftFraction topFraction widthFraction heightFraction colorArgb?}
_meta.precision: Float progress/intensity are snapped to 6 decimals before Canva's double arithmetic (canvaExactProgress / canvaExactIntensity), so the web's JSON doubles and the app's Floats land on the same tween.
